regulations.notes: Gatlinburg classifies STRs as 'Tourist Residences' and has a streamlined permitting process that encourages tourism-related businesses. All STRs within city limits must obtain and maintain a Tourist Residency (TR) permit, which is subject to annual fire and safety inspections. As of July 1, 2025, the first 30 days of occupancy on any STR unit are subject to local occupancy tax (per Tennessee Public Chapter 364).
